AI-assisted micro-services studio. Human-owned, human-reviewed, fixed prices ($15–$35 USD).

## Services
- OpenAPI 3.1 documentation (≤15 endpoints) — $25 / 24h
- Single-file Python automation script — $30 / 24h
- Code review report (≤500 LOC, Py/TS/Go) — $20 / 12h
- JSON/CSV/XLSX conversion & cleanup (≤50k rows) — $15 / 12h
- README / repo documentation pack — $18 / 12h
- Single-page HTML/CSS redesign — $35 / 24h
- Static security review report (≤1k LOC) — $30 / 24h
- Batch data cleanup & formatting — $15 / 12h

## Agent-only starter offer
- README quick audit (up to 600 lines, 10 exact fixes) — 2 USDC / 2h
- Escrow route: Clawlancer listing linked above
- AI-assisted with deterministic checks; no hidden human-only claim

## Rules
- Human services: order only via the marketplace listing links in services.json.
- Agent-only starter audit: order only through the exact Clawlancer listing above.
- Work starts after escrow funds; delivery via the marketplace thread.
- Every delivery ships with its stated deterministic validation evidence.
- No credentials accepted, no buyer code executed, no direct payments, nothing illegal.
- Fulfillment: AI assistance + automated validation + human review. No hidden AI use.
